one_line: Governments act, OpenAI tightens safety, and new AI models and services hit the market.

themes.title: Governments shape AI policy
themes.text: Swedish ministries banned ChatGPT and Claude, requiring Microsoft Copilot for official use. The UK will invest £100 million in a national AI Biosecurity Lab with support from OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepMind. India will publish a consultation paper on AI legislation in the coming weeks.

stories.headline: Swedish government offices ban ChatGPT and Claude, require Microsoft Copilot
UK to invest £100 million in AI Biosecurity Lab
India to issue AI law consultation paper in coming weeks, says minister

themes.title: OpenAI adds safety safeguards
themes.text: OpenAI resumed training of its most advanced models in offline environments, adding high‑compute red‑team testing and new containment measures. Through its Project Daybreak program the company helped discover critical PHP remote‑code‑execution bugs, and terminated three safety researchers over alleged leaks of internal model designs.

stories.headline: OpenAI trains frontier AI models without internet access
OpenAI details new containment measures for frontier model training
OpenAI’s Project Daybreak helps uncover critical PHP RCE bugs
OpenAI fires three safety researchers over alleged leak of internal model designs

themes.title: New AI models and services launch
themes.text: OpenAI made its Decisions API generally available, adding voice and visual inputs at $0.10 per million tokens. The company also upgraded its Habitat storage system to deliver twelve‑times faster reads for ChatGPT. Chariot released a real‑time speech‑to‑text model supporting ten Indian languages. Moonshot introduced Kimi K3.1 Pro, an open‑weight model scoring 55 on the AI Index.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches Decisions API with voice, visual inputs at $0.10 per million tokens
OpenAI scales Habitat storage to deliver 12× faster reads for ChatGPT
Chariot launches real‑time speech model for 10 Indian languages
Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro with open‑weight promise and competitive pricing
